whoAmI.title: Who I Am
whoAmI.content: Frontend Developer with almost 12 years of experience in web application development, working on complex and high-impact projects. Strong expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, specializing in Angular, React, and Next.js as well as best practices in software architecture and performance.

sectorExperience.title: Sector Experience
sectorExperience.content: Experience in restaurant, fintech, education, and healthcare sectors, leading the development of scalable and modern systems. Skilled in monorepos (Nx), automated testing (Jest, Cypress), microfrontends (Module Federation), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Firebase, Vercel). Advanced knowledge in design systems, accessibility, and UI/UX.

leadershipDevelopment.title: Leadership & Development
leadershipDevelopment.content: Proven experience in mentoring developers, team leadership, and facilitating the migration of legacy systems to modern technologies. Always up-to-date with market best practices, constantly seeking to learn, innovate, and optimize development processes.

featured.label: Featured project
featured.title: Ladôme Ateliê
featured.subtitle: Website and back office for a crochet bag atelier
featured.description: A catalogue that feels handmade. The site brings the atelier’s craft to the screen with three.js and shaders, and the sale closes in a WhatsApp conversation with the order already written. Behind it, a panel runs the atelier’s day.

knit.title: Real knit, alive
knit.text: The cover is a photograph of the brand’s own knit, animated by a GLSL shader: relief under a slowly turning light, fabric that breathes and gives under your finger.

thread.title: A thread that sews the page
thread.text: A 3D yarn (React Three Fiber) runs down the page, stitches the frames and tags, and ends in a rolling ball of yarn.

globe.title: Who already has a Ladôme
globe.text: Testimonials sit on a WebGL globe, with a thread tying each city to its review.

whatsapp.title: From the clothesline to WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Bags hang as paper tags on a clothesline; the cart becomes a written order and opens the chat with the atelier.

featured.cmsText: Pieces and their versions, the shelf of materials, pricing, production and stock, orders, customers and coupons, and the site’s copy with a live preview. All on one Supabase project, with the business rules in SQL functions.

images.cover: The site’s cover: the logo over the animated wine knit
images.phone: The site’s cover on a phone

lead.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Lead frontend architecture and technical strategy, focusing on scalability, performance and code quality.
Mentor frontend engineers, supporting professional development, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.
Take part in requirements refinement, technical planning and solution design alongside Product, Design and Engineering.
Drive technical decisions and guide the implementation of complex frontend solutions, keeping the architecture consistent and maintainable.

senior.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Developed and evolved Fintalk Studio, the core platform for managing conversational AI products, with scalable, high-performance frontend workflows.
Built and maintained the conversational bot builder, which lets non-technical users create and manage intelligent chatbots through an intuitive interface.
Contributed to Fintalk’s new institutional landing page, ensuring design consistency, performance and alignment with product and marketing goals.

lead.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Led the company’s overall frontend architecture, applying best practices and creating reusable libraries.
Led and built a customizable menu system with Next.js/React.js, designed for flexibility and scale.
Led and built a centralized admin system for all the company’s products, with NX, microfrontends, Dynamic Federation and Angular 18.

senior.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Led the maintenance and evolution of a custom menu system used across many restaurant operations.
Built new features and improvements for the Admin platform, making menu configuration and management efficient.
Worked with Angular, React.js/Next.js and Tailwind CSS to deliver scalable, high-quality frontend solutions.

senior.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Worked on many web projects at a literary and educational company, across a wide range of technologies and products.
Maintained and improved a CMS built with Vue.js 2.0, keeping editorial workflows stable and fast.
Built landing pages for ebooks, audiobooks and minibooks with Angular 10, improving marketing reach and conversion.
Built the new institutional website with Next.js/React, modernizing the company’s digital presence.
Customized and extended the Skeelo store on Shopify with JavaScript and Sass, and later led its full rewrite in Next.js with Mercado Pago.
Built the new React web app, bringing the Skeelo app’s key features — bookshelves and audiobooks — to the browser.
Contributed to a web reader that lets users read books on the desktop.
Defined frontend architecture and best practices for several projects with the Tech Lead.
Mentored interns and junior developers.

senior.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Worked in the Pj Emps squad of Itaú Bank’s Insurance tribe, on high-impact financial and operational systems.
Built the end-to-end workflow for insurance consultants: onboarding, renewal, retention, delinquency and operations.
Built reporting screens and scheduling tools for the consultants.
Worked in an Nx monorepo built for scale and modular development.
Developed mostly in Angular, with parts in React and Web Components.
Wrote unit tests with Jest.
Managed source control with Gitflow.
Set up the build and deploy pipelines on AWS.

senior.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Worked on a team responsible for several business fronts, including Shift, Accreditation, Corporate and Shielding.
Maintained and evolved legacy systems built with JSP (JavaServer Pages), with jQuery on the frontend where needed.
Took part in migrating key parts of the projects to Angular 4+, modernizing the frontend.

senior.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Worked on the team behind Comexport’s main product, which runs the whole trading workflow and core business operations.
Developed extensively in Angular, from version 4 through the migration to Angular 10, for a modern, stable and efficient experience.

senior.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Worked on both the frontend (Angular) and the backend (Python/Flask), with a strong technical presence across cross-functional initiatives.
Took part in major government projects such as STF Case Law, building its whole frontend for simple and advanced search.
Contributed to the STF CMS module, an internal system for content and case management.
Worked with MySQL and PostgreSQL for data consumption and validation.
Wrote automated end-to-end tests with Cypress, improving reliability and regression coverage.
Supported the platform’s users, helping keep the product’s quality and their satisfaction.
Took on broader responsibilities in UX, engineering leadership and process facilitation on reaching senior level.
Acted as Scrum Master for about eight months: sprint planning, daily stand-ups and agile workflows.
Worked as UX designer on some projects, creating prototypes and wireframes.
Gave Digesto Talks internal sessions on Angular and its concepts.
Mentored junior developers in Angular and React, shaping onboarding, best practices and team culture.

engineer.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Supported, customized and evolved the company’s flagship product, Digesto Procedural Information, used by lawyers, law firms and companies to track and distribute legal cases.
Built frontend features with Angular 7, 8 and 9, HTML5, Sass and Angular Material.
Contributed to the backend with Python, Flask and Flask Potion, on API integrations and admin modules.

frontend.title: Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Worked on several projects in the financial sector, on key platforms and internal systems.
Built dynamic, responsive interfaces with Angular 6 for financial operations.
Styled the frontend with Sass, for modern and consistent layouts.
Contributed to the backend with .NET Core, on business logic and critical features.
Worked with MySQL for persistence, modeling and data retrieval.
Used Git for source control and collaboration.
Built the ImparCapital platform’s frontend from the ground up: a secure, reliable product for choosing, monitoring and reviewing investments.

fullStack.title: Full Stack Engineer
responsibilities: Built frontend features for a medical support system with AngularJS, improving healthcare professionals’ workflows.
Styled the interface with Sass, for a consistent, modern and friendly experience.
Contributed to the backend with .NET Core.
Managed source code with SVN.
Solved a key challenge: page breaks in the text editor, like Microsoft Word’s, for doctors who relied heavily on document formatting.

fullStack.title: Full Stack Engineer
responsibilities: Worked end to end on a student social network.
Built the frontend with AngularJS, Gulp for the workflow and LESS for styling.
Built the backend with Node.js: authentication, data processing and platform features.
Used MongoDB as the NoSQL database.
Integrated Firebase for real-time notifications.
Built the platform’s real-time chat with Socket.IO.
Tracked user behavior with Google Analytics.
